response.sql: WITH fee_order_user AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, f.feerate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), pair_averages AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, AVG(feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fee_order_user GROUP BY orderslink, acctscope), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_feerate FROM pair_averages), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT pa.orderslink, pa.acctscope, pa.avg_feerate, pa.avg_feerate - om.mean_feerate AS excess FROM pair_averages pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE pa.avg_feerate > om.mean_feerate), ranked_pairs AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rank FROM filtered_pairs) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank FROM ranked_pairs WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rank;

assumptions.assumption: INNER JOINs enforce that all fees must match to an order and user; fees without matches are excluded, implementing 'drop any fee without a match'
